senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; שָׁאַל)request, esp. sh’elah, prayer for rain, inserted in the ninth section of the Prayer of Benedictions.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:2">Ber. V, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 33a:31">33ᵃ</cite>), v. <cite ref="U00030"><he>שָׁאַל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 26b">Ber. 26ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 29a:24">29ᵃ</cite> <he>טעה … ש׳ בברכת השנים</he> (v. Ms. M. in Rabb. D. S. a. l.) if by mistake … he omitted the prayer for rain in the ninth section; (Tosef. ib. III, 9 <he>ולא שאל את הגשמים</he>).

<cite ref="Taanit 4b:11">Taan. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ לחוד והזכרה לחוד</he> prayer for rain is one thing, and reference to rain (in the second section) is another thing, v. <cite ref="E00298"><he>הַזְכָּרָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 2b:8">Ib. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>משעה שמפסיק לש׳ וכ׳</he> when you cease to insert the prayer for rain, you must also cease to insert the reference to rain; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 116a:12">B. Kam. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>זו ש׳ היא</he> Ms. H. (ed. <he>וזו שאילה</he>) this is indeed a question (worth asking); <cite ref="Zevachim 30b:9">Zeb. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 92b:20">92ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:3">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ גדולה שאלת</he> thou hast asked a great question; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (v. שָׁאַל, Nif.) ritual question, esp. case of absolution from a vow brought before a scholar.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11">Num. R. s. 11<sup>3</sup></cite> <he>אם באת … על הדין ועל הש׳ וכ׳</he> when a woman comes to thee at college to ask concerning a law or a vow, consider her as if she were thy own daughter.
<cite ref="Nedarim 60a:8">Ned. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>צריך ש׳ לחכם</he> this requires absolution by a scholar.

<cite ref="Nedarim 69a:3">Ib. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>יש ש׳ בהקם</he> can absolution from confirmation be applied for? <cite ref="Nedarim 78a:5">Ib. 78ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 120b:7">B. Bath. 120ᵇ</cite> <he>יש ש׳ בהקדש</he> absolution from consecration of an object may eventually be had; <he>אין ש׳ וכ׳</he> is not admissible; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁאֵלוֹת</he>, <cite ref="U00033"><he>שְׁאֵי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:8">Gen. R. s. 82</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 136:1">Yalk. ib. 136</cite> <he>שלש ש׳ אני וכ׳</he> I shall ask you three questions; if you answer them, it is right &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:9">Gen. R. s. 49</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01267"><he>עִרְבּוּב</he></cite>; a. e.
